[5:20PM] #VI #TrafficUpdate 

Steady movement descending from the Mecwen bridge towards the Bonny Camp roundabout. While traffic from Bonny Camp inward Ahmadu Bello Way is clear, and Ahmadu Bello Way towards Adetokunbo Ademola is also flowing well, traffic is gathering from the Eko Hotel exit gate towards the Eko Hotel roundabout due to the closing hour rush and intersection congestion. 

Ajose Adeogun heading towards Ligali Ayorinde/Oniru Water Cooperation is experiencing steady movement, while the return journey towards Eko Hotel roundabout back to Sanusi Fafunwa is currently moving. Underneath the Bonny Camp bridge, vehicular movement towards Kofo Abayomi is steady, and Kofo Abayomi towards Oniru Kilimanjaro is also moving. Kilimanjaro inward to Akin Adeshola, connecting to Law School, is busy but moving.

 Law School inward Civic Center en route BJ 1004 is also experiencing busy but moving traffic due to the evening rush and a high volume of vehicles. The School Corner area inward to Sandfield is moving, and Sandfield inward to the Toll Plaza is clear. Traffic is steady from the Toll Plaza towards Lekki, becoming busy as it approaches the Lekki intersection due to a high influx of vehicles heading to the Lekki Peninsula. 

On the return journey from Lekki inward to Sandfield via School Corner down to Civic Center, vehicular movement is steady. Civic Center en route the Ramp Bridge is moving well, although traffic islows down from the tip of the Ramp Bridge inward towards Falomo. The route from Civic Center to Akin Adeshola down to Oniru Kilimanjaro is clear.

 Conversely, Kilimanjaro inward to Kofo Abayomi down to Bonny Camp is busy but moving due to the closing hour rush and high vehicle volume, compounded by the intersection under the Bonny Camp bridge. Similarly, Bonny Camp en route McWen is also busy due to the same factors. There are currently slowing points at various locations within this corridor. No obstructions have been reported, and our officers are visibly present to manage the flow.

#FollowLASTMA

[5:51PM] #CBD_Marina #TrafficUpdate

 A smooth flow of traffic is observed from the UBA roundabout towards the NNPC filling station and along Cathedral Church down to the Nitel intersection. Similarly, movement from the State House connecting to Force Road is reported as good. 

Traffic is moving at a faster pace from Zone 2 underneath the bridge towards Flag Staff House, leading to the Mecwen bridge. A perfect movement of traffic is observed from the Onikan roundabout towards TBS, and inward Nitel intersection. 

Along Broad Street, traffic is flowing well from General Hospital towards Tinubu Square, but approaching Abibu Oki Street and heading inward Apongbon, movement becomes slow and steady due to commercial activities. 

The entire stretch of Igbosere Road and Catholic Mission Street, connecting to Ganiu Smith Street, is experiencing faster movement. No impediments to traffic have been noted, and personnel are well-positioned to manage the traffic situation.

#FollowLASTMA

[5:46PM] #Ikorodu #TrafficUpdate  

Good flow from Benson towards the Ikorodu interchange. The journey further inward to Sabo roundabout, and along the route connecting Ile-Epo Oba, LASTMA yard, Sawmill, First Gate, Jendol, leading to Odonguyan, is also experiencing fast movement. 

The area remains calm from the Ikorodu roundabout inward Ojubode, the Oba Ayangburen's palace, and Ojogbe. The return journey from Ojubode connecting to Ladega is steady, while traffic heading towards Onishigida, Itunpate, and Itunmeko is flowing smoothly, with a slight delay observed when approaching the Ota-Ona corridor due to alternation delays. 

A fast-moving traffic situation persists from Ota-Ona inward Grammar School and Erunwen en route the Itamaga intersection, although the return journey encounters busy conditions when approaching the Ota-Ona intersection, attributed to alternation delays. Our personnel are present at key locations, ensuring unimpeded flow of traffic. 

#FollowLASTMA

data.raw_text:
[6:40PM] #Dopemu #TrafficUpdate 

Good traffic flow from Cement to Dopemu underneath the bridge, extending to Pako, Adealu, and Goye intersection, proceeding inward to Iyana Ipaja.
Smooth vehicular movement from Goye intersection to Alaguntan, Alimosho Road.
Akiwowo Cash Street connecting to Moshalashi (both inward and outward directions) is good.
Good traffic movement on Dopemu Bridge to Akowonjo Roundabout, ShaSha traffic light to Cele, Shobo, Kwara, Jimoh, Vulcanizer, and Micom.

Slow movement approaching Bakery and Ogunlana Junction, connecting to Egbeda, attributed to heightened commercial activities. However, our personnel are strategically on ground to monitor and manage the traffic effectively.

Return journey is good from Egbeda inw Lagos-Abeokuta Expressway, extending to Swipha, Agbotikuyo, Oniwaya, Dopemu, and its adjoining roads.

#FollowLASTMA
